name: Kleinian Limit Set
recipe: An Indra's-Pearls Kleinian-group limit set: two Mobius transformations generate an infinite fractal necklace of nested tangent circles / pearls spiralling into self-similar filigree (Schottky group). Slowly vary the group parameters (the trace) on K.t so the pearl-froth breathes between a loose chain and a dense fractal dust. Default COLORFUL: pearls/circles hued by generation-depth through an iq palette, glowing on dark, luminance ~0.18-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: generate the Schottky/Kleinian limit set by iterating a pair of Mobius maps (DFS to a depth/epsilon, cache points in S), draw the tangent circles / limit points with additive glow hued by word-length; vary the generator trace (t) slowly on K.t so the froth morphs. Fills frame.
style: pearls (default, depth-hued glowing circles). Also: gold-froth, neon-dust, ice, ink (named mono).

name: Bifurcation Diagram
recipe: The logistic-map bifurcation diagram: the period-doubling cascade into chaos — a single line splitting to 2, 4, 8, ... then a chaotic haze shot through with periodic windows, the iconic fig-tree fractal of dynamical systems. A vertical scan-line sweeps the r-axis revealing it column by column, and the r-window slowly zooms/pans on K.t into the self-similar detail. Default COLORFUL: point density (escape/orbit) hued (cool stable -> hot chaotic) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: per column x -> r value; iterate the logistic map x=r x(1-x), plot the attractor orbit points (after burn-in) up the column with density-glow, hue by local Lyapunov (stable cool / chaotic hot); a sweep reveals columns + the r-window pans/zooms on K.t. Fills frame.
style: figtree (default, stable-cool/chaos-hot). Also: phosphor (green), thermal, gold-on-black, blueprint (white on blue).

name: Lorenz-96 Ring
recipe: The Lorenz-96 model: a ring of coupled variables (a toy climate/atmosphere) whose advective coupling breeds travelling waves of spatiotemporal chaos — draw it as a scrolling Hovmoller space-time diagram (site around a ring vs time) so chaotic wave-fronts sweep and merge across the frame. Forcing F drifts on K.section (ordered waves <-> full chaos). Default COLORFUL: amplitude through a diverging colormap (blue neg -> white -> red pos) scrolling, luminance ~0.25-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: a ring of N variables in S integrated with the Lorenz-96 ODE (dxi/dt=(x_{i+1}-x_{i-2})x_{i-1}-x_i+F); each frame push the current ring state as a new row into a scrolling space-time buffer, map value->diverging LUT; F drifts on K.section. Scroll + chaos = motion.
style: hovmoller (default, blue-white-red diverging). Also: thermal, viridis, ice, mono (named).

name: Wave Terrain
recipe: Wave-terrain synthesis: a 3D terrain surface z=f(x,y) (a sum of sines / ridged noise) is traversed by an orbiting readout path, and the whole terrain is rendered as glowing contour/iso lines or a shaded relief that undulates as the surface's phases evolve — an oscilloscope-terrain hybrid. Default COLORFUL: iso-contour lines through a spectral ramp on a dark shaded relief, a bright readout dot orbiting; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame, undulating on K.t.
kernel: per-pixel or contour: evaluate a wave-terrain field z=sum sin(a x)+sin(b y)+cross-terms with phases drifting on K.t; draw iso-contours (bands of z) with spectral hue + a shaded relief (gradient), plus an orbiting readout point tracing a Lissajous path on the surface. Undulation = motion.
style: contour-relief (default, spectral iso-lines). Also: thermal, wireframe-grid, aurora, blueprint (named mono).

name: ODE Phase Portrait
recipe: The phase portrait of a 2D dynamical system: streamlines and a swarm of tracer particles flow along the vector field toward spirals, saddles, limit-cycles and centres, with the nullclines and fixed points marked — a living map of a differential equation. Cycle the system (pendulum, Van der Pol limit cycle, predator-prey, Duffing) on K.section so the flow topology transforms. Default COLORFUL: tracers hued by speed streaming along glowing streamlines on dark, fixed points bright; luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: choose a 2D ODE (params drift on K.section); advect ~1500 tracer particles along the field into a fade-trail buffer (hue by speed), draw faint streamlines + mark nullclines/fixed points; reseed tracers. Van der Pol / Duffing give lovely limit cycles. Continuous flow = motion.
style: streamflow (default, speed-hued tracers). Also: aurora, ember, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Halvorsen Attractor
recipe: The Halvorsen attractor: a cyclically-symmetric 3D chaotic system that winds into a beautiful spiralling triple-lobed shell of dense filaments. Rotate the 3D projection on incommensurate K.t rates; drift the parameter so it breathes. Default COLORFUL: density+depth log-mapped through a palette (violet->cyan->gold) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35. Accumulate 40-70k iterates/frame with bright splats so it is dense/bright (NOT sparse).
kernel: iterate Halvorsen ODE (x'=-a x-4y-4z-y^2 cyclic; a~1.4; dt~.005) 40-70k/frame; rotate+project, splat bright into a density buffer shaded by z; log-map palette LUT, upscale. Two incommensurate rotation rates = motion.
style: triple-shell (default, violet->cyan->gold). Also: plasma, ember, ice, pencil (named mono).

name: Living Constellations
recipe: FIX #2 of a baseline asset that is STILL FROZEN (motion 0.0047 even after a rotation attempt). The rotation was too slow. Re-author with UNAMBIGUOUS continuous motion: (1) the whole star sphere rotates at a clearly-visible rate so stars sweep across the frame over a few seconds, AND (2) stars have individual parallax drift, AND (3) frequent shooting stars streak across, AND (4) constellation lines continuously form/dissolve. Snapshots 8s apart MUST differ clearly (target motion 0.02-0.15). Keep it bright (lum 0.15-0.35) — white/blue stars + cyan/gold lines on deep night-blue with a faint nebula.
kernel: star array rotated by angle = K.t * rate (rate large enough that stars visibly move over 8s — NOT a crawl) + per-star parallax drift; twinkle; shooting stars spawn on K.t; constellation polylines reform on K.section. VERIFY the 8s displacement is large. Bright, full, clearly moving.
style: night-sky (default, white/blue stars + cyan/gold lines). Also: zodiac-gold, aurora-sky, blueprint, mono (named).

name: Flow Calligraphy
recipe: FIX of a version that rendered as BLANK PAPER (strokes invisible, motion 0.0002 — broken). Re-author so BOLD visible ink strokes are CONTINUOUSLY drawn and clearly move: many tapered brush strokes following a flow field, drawn dark/saturated and THICK enough to read on the ground, accumulating then slowly washing away so new strokes always appear (motion >0.03). Make sure strokes are actually rendered (test that the buffer fills with visible marks, not empty). Default COLORFUL: rich sumi-black OR jewel-hued strokes with wet bleed on warm paper (or luminous strokes on dark); luminance ~0.25-0.5, fills frame with calligraphic marks.
kernel: brush agents integrate along a noise flow field drawing THICK tapered variable-width strokes (visible weight 3-12px) into a buffer that fades slowly; spawn new strokes every frame on K.t so marks continuously appear and the composition evolves; ensure marks are dark/bright enough to read. Continuous writing = motion. Verify non-empty output.
style: sumi (default, bold black ink + bleed on warm paper). Also: jewel-ink (hued on dark), gold-leaf, neon-brush, blueprint (white on blue).

name: Metaball Mercury
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is too DARK (lum 0.09 — chrome blobs barely visible on near-black). Re-author BRIGHT: liquid-metal metaballs merging and splitting with luminous iso-band shading + a bright specular highlight so the mercury blobs POP (lum 0.2-0.5), on a mid-dark ground not pure black. Charges orbit on K.t. Default COLORFUL: chrome-teal->magenta iso-bands with bright rim/highlight, clearly visible molten blobs.
kernel: coarse per-pixel buffer: sum_i r^2/dist^2 over ~7 orbiting charges; near iso=1 draw the bright surface + specular, band the field for colour with an iq palette; keep the ground a dim tone not black so it reads. Orbiting = motion. Bright + visible.
style: mercury (default, chrome-teal->magenta + highlight). Also: lava (orange gooey), x-ray (glowing iso), oil-chrome (iridescent), ink (named mono).

name: Feedback Paint
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is DARK/SPARSE (lum 0.09 — faint specks on black). Re-author as a LUSH generative paint/feedback field: injected brush blobs smeared by a video-feedback warp (advect + rotate + scale the previous frame) into flowing marbled paint that FILLS the frame with rich colour (lum 0.2-0.5), continuously fed so it never empties. Default COLORFUL: vivid multi-hue paint smearing through the feedback flow on a toned ground, clearly moving.
kernel: persistent buffer: each frame warp it (advect by a noise flow + slight rotate/scale) at ~0.92 alpha, then inject several bright colored brush blobs (hue drifting on K.t); the feedback smears them into marbled flow. Guard wash-out. Fill the frame, keep bright + flowing.
style: marbled-paint (default, vivid multi-hue smear). Also: oil-slick, ember-flow, ink-in-water, neon.

name: Orrery
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is DARK (lum 0.10) and near-STATIC (motion 0.012). Re-author as a luminous mechanical orrery / solar-system model: a bright central sun with several planets on visibly ORBITING elliptical paths (clearly moving over a few seconds), glowing orbit rings, moons around planets, a comet on a long ellipse, subtle gear/armillary rings — a living clockwork cosmos. Make it BRIGHTER (lum 0.15-0.4) and clearly MOVING (planets sweep their orbits, motion 0.02-0.1). Default COLORFUL: warm sun + jewel-hued planets + glowing brass orbit rings on deep space.
kernel: draw the sun (bright radial glow) + N planets at angle = K.t * (orbital rate per planet, faster inner) on elliptical orbits (glowing rings), moons orbiting planets, a comet with a tail; slow armillary-ring rotation. Planets must visibly move over 8s. Bright + dynamic.
style: brass-cosmos (default, sun + jewel planets + brass rings). Also: neon-orrery, blueprint (white on blue), zodiac-gold, mono (named).

name: Reaction-Diffusion
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is WASHED-OUT / PALE (lum 0.82 — faint dark spots on near-white, low contrast). Re-author with RICH CONTRAST and COLOR: a proper Gray-Scott / Turing pattern where the structure is BOLD and saturated (not pale spots on white) — vivid coral/maze/spots through a high-contrast palette on a deep ground, luminance ~0.25-0.5. Keep it perpetually growing/dividing. Default COLORFUL: saturated teal/magenta/gold reaction pattern, clearly high-contrast.
kernel: Gray-Scott RD in S (<=170 wide), feed/kill tuned for coral/mitosis; map V through a HIGH-CONTRAST vivid palette LUT (deep ground -> bright structure), NOT pale-on-white; upscale. Intrinsic growth = motion. Bold + saturated.
style: coral (default, saturated teal/magenta/gold). Also: bone, thermal, moss, ink-maze (named mono).
